items.name: pyridine
items.desc: a six-membered aromatic ring containing one nitrogen

items.name: ethyl acetate
items.desc: CH3-C(=O)-O-CH2CH3: an acetyl group joined through oxygen to an ethyl group

items.name: acetone
items.desc: a carbonyl carbon carrying two methyl groups

items.name: acetic acid
items.desc: CH3 on a carbon that is C=O and OH

items.name: diethyl ether
items.desc: an oxygen joined to two ethyl groups

items.name: dichloromethane
items.desc: one carbon carrying two chlorines (and two hydrogens)

items.name: toluene
items.desc: a benzene ring with one methyl group

items.name: hexane
items.desc: an unbranched chain of six carbons

items.name: tetrahydrofuran
items.desc: a saturated five-membered ring of four carbons and one oxygen

items.name: ethanol
items.desc: a two-carbon chain ending in OH

items.name: sodium sulfate
items.desc: sulfate (S with two S=O and two O-) with two Na+ counter-ions

items.name: nitric acid
items.desc: N with OH, one N=O and one O- (formal charges N+ and O-)

items.name: hydrogen peroxide
items.desc: two oxygens joined by a single bond, each with one hydrogen (HO-OH)

items.name: dimethyldichlorosilane
items.desc: silicon bearing two methyl and two chlorine substituents

items.name: sulfuric acid
items.desc: sulfur with two S=O and two OH groups

items.name: sodium borohydride
items.desc: a tetrahedral BH4- anion with a Na+ counter-ion

items.name: carbon dioxide
items.desc: a linear molecule, O=C=O

items.name: phosphoric acid
items.desc: phosphorus with one P=O and three OH groups

items.name: boric oxide
items.desc: two borons joined by an oxygen bridge, each also with a B=O

items.name: sodium cyanate
items.desc: a Na+ counter-ion with the cyanate anion, OCN-

items.name: zinc nitrate
items.desc: Zn2+ with two nitrate anions

items.name: sodium nitrite
items.desc: Na+ with the nitrite anion O=N-O-

items.name: potassium iodide
items.desc: K+ and I-

items.name: hydrochloric acid
items.desc: H-Cl

items.name: iodine
items.desc: two iodine atoms joined by a single bond

items.name: ammonium chloride
items.desc: a tetrahedral NH4+ cation with Cl-

items.name: magnesium sulfate
items.desc: Mg2+ with the sulfate anion

items.name: sodium bicarbonate
items.desc: Na+ with hydrogencarbonate: C with one C=O, one O- and one OH

items.name: potassium hydroxide
items.desc: K+ with HO-

items.name: potassium permanganate
items.desc: K+ with the permanganate anion: Mn with three Mn=O and one Mn-O-

items.name: 4-aminophenol
items.desc: a benzene ring with NH2 and OH para to each other

items.name: acetic anhydride
items.desc: two acetyl groups joined through one oxygen

items.name: phenol
items.desc: a benzene ring with one OH

items.name: p-toluenesulfonyl chloride (TsCl)
items.desc: a benzene ring with CH3 and SO2Cl para to each other

items.name: benzaldehyde
items.desc: a benzene ring carrying CHO

items.name: 2,5-dimethoxytetrahydrofuran
items.desc: a saturated five-membered ring with one oxygen and OCH3 groups on both carbons next to that oxygen

items.name: p-toluenesulfonamide
items.desc: a benzene ring with CH3 and SO2NH2 para to each other

items.name: benzil
items.desc: two C=O groups joined directly, each carrying a phenyl

items.name: 1,3-diphenylacetone
items.desc: a C=O flanked by two CH2 groups, each carrying a phenyl

items.name: pyrrole
items.desc: a five-membered aromatic ring of four carbons and an NH

items.name: paracetamol
items.desc: a benzene ring with OH and an NHC(=O)CH3 amide, para to each other

items.name: phenyl toluene-p-sulfonate
items.desc: a tolyl-SO2 group joined through oxygen to a phenyl ring

items.name: dibenzalacetone
items.desc: a C=O with a CH=CH-phenyl on each side

items.name: 1-(p-toluenesulfonyl)pyrrole
items.desc: a tolyl-SO2 group on the nitrogen of a pyrrole ring

items.name: tetraphenylcyclopentadienone
items.desc: a five-membered ring with a C=O and two C=C, each ring carbon (other than C=O) carrying a phenyl

items.name: methyl benzoate
items.desc: a benzene ring carrying CO2CH3

items.name: methyl 3-nitrobenzoate
items.desc: a benzene ring with CO2CH3 and NO2 meta to each other

items.name: 1,2-dimethoxybenzene (veratrole)
items.desc: a benzene ring with two OCH3 groups on adjacent carbons

items.name: 1,2-dimethoxy-4,5-dinitrobenzene
items.desc: a benzene ring with two adjacent OCH3 and two adjacent NO2 groups, on the other four carbons

items.name: 1,3-benzodioxole (methylenedioxybenzene)
items.desc: a benzene ring fused to a five-membered ring O-CH2-O

items.name: 5-nitro-1,3-benzodioxole
items.desc: the benzodioxole with one NO2 on the benzene ring, para to one ring oxygen

items.name: anthranilic acid (2-aminobenzoic acid)
items.desc: a benzene ring with NH2 and CO2H on adjacent carbons

items.name: 2-iodobenzoic acid
items.desc: a benzene ring with I and CO2H on adjacent carbons

items.name: trifluoroacetic anhydride
items.desc: two CF3-C(=O) groups joined through one oxygen

items.name: 2-trifluoroacetylpyrrole
items.desc: a pyrrole ring (with NH) carrying C(=O)CF3 on the carbon next to nitrogen

items.name: ethyl acetoacetate
items.desc: CH3-C(=O)-CH2-C(=O)-O-CH2CH3

items.name: ethyl (S)-3-hydroxybutanoate
items.desc: CH3-CH(OH)-CH2-CO2Et, with the stereocentre drawn as (S) (wedge or dash)

items.name: disodium hydrogen phosphate
items.desc: phosphorus with one P=O, one OH and two O- groups, with two Na+

items.name: bromobenzene
items.desc: a benzene ring with one Br

items.name: phenylmagnesium bromide
items.desc: a benzene ring with an Mg-Br group bonded to carbon

items.name: benzoic acid
items.desc: a benzene ring carrying CO2H

items.name: biphenyl
items.desc: two benzene rings joined by one C-C bond

items.name: poly(dimethylsiloxane) repeat unit
items.desc: a chain of alternating Si and O, each Si carrying two methyl groups

items.name: silicon dioxide (silica)
items.desc: Si joined to two oxygens by double bonds

items.name: sodium acetate
items.desc: CH3 on a carboxylate carbon (C=O and O-) with Na+

items.name: acetylacetone (pentane-2,4-dione, keto form)
items.desc: CH3-C(=O)-CH2-C(=O)-CH3
